responsibility: This file implements GCC’s GIMPLE tracer pass for superblock formation via tail duplication. Guided by profile counts and branch probabilities, it ranks blocks, finds hot traces by following best predecessors and successors, duplicates eligible tail blocks when profitable, updates PHIs and CFG state after duplication, and returns cleanup requests when the CFG changed. Its responsibility is profile-driven trace construction and tail duplication for block layout and later optimization opportunities, not generic block duplication infrastructure by itself.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/tracer.h, this is the implementation of the tracer pass itself: it computes trace heuristics, finds hot predecessor/successor chains, performs tail-duplication through transform_duplicate, and defines the pass_tracer GIMPLE pass, while the header only exposes the small reusable interface.
